changelog: Beta: 'Run again' button on finished amplicon jobs — runs the pipeline again on the same input files with the recorded settings (thread count can be changed), e.g. after installing chopper / VSEARCH. The job's current results are replaced. ONT 16S new-job form gets a CPU threads field (default 8; Emu used to run on 4). Frontend only, no restart needed.

previous.changelog: Amplicon PDF report (Emu runs): the Method and QC text now follow the run log. When chopper or VSEARCH was not found and the step was skipped, the report says so instead of describing a quality filter or chimera removal that did not happen. No restart needed.
